ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the figure is a schematic profile along 45°N of an ideal continent, with continent in the center and ocean on both sides; near the right edge of the continent it is marked ④, and on the ocean to the right it is marked ⑤. In the upper right of the figure there are two near-surface isobaric surfaces labeled M and N, and they show a form of sloping downward from near ④ toward ⑤ on the right. Reasoning: if M and N represent near-surface isobaric surfaces, then the side where the isobaric surface height is higher corresponds to higher near-surface air pressure. The isobaric surfaces lowering toward the vicinity of ⑤ indicates that near-surface air pressure near ④ is higher and near-surface air pressure near ⑤ is lower. Near-surface wind generally blows from high pressure to low pressure, so in this season the prevailing wind direction near the surface is from ④ to ⑤.

raw_record.original_question:
读“沿某一理想大陆45°N所作的剖面示意图”。

<image1>

若图中M、N表示近地面的等压面，则该季节近地面的盛行风向是从哪里吹向哪里？
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: the figure is a schematic profile along 45°N of an ideal continent, with continent in the center and ocean on both sides; near the right edge of the continent it is marked ④, and on the ocean to the right it is marked ⑤. In the upper right of the figure there are two near-surface isobaric surfaces labeled M and N, and they show a form of sloping downward from near ④ toward ⑤ on the right. Reasoning: if M and N represent near-surface isobaric surfaces, then the side where the isobaric surface height is higher corresponds to higher near-surface air pressure. The isobaric surfaces lowering toward the vicinity of ⑤ indicates that near-surface air pressure near ④ is higher and near-surface air pressure near ⑤ is lower. Near-surface wind generally blows from high pressure to low pressure, so in this season the prevailing wind direction near the surface is from ④ to ⑤.
